text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Did you see that, sir?! You 
witnessed my victory!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"This is entirely thanks to your
guidance, 
Boss!"
choice_data_list: That was the best run ever!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Because you guided me all the way here 
when I was agonizing over my inability to 
carry out my own justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've taken another step 
closer to the hero of justice I'm
striving 
to be, sir!

I shall continue to charge down the path 
of justice alongside the Boss, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I can become the hero of 
justice I strive to be!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno

Of course, sir! I am still far too 
inexperienced to call myself an ally of 
justice, after all.

I intend to continue striving forward so 
that my continued victories may serve
as a 
fine example!
